source_interpretation.source_role: semantic identity and physical construction evidence only; source pixels are never a cutout, foreground plate or lighting authority
preserve: product class, count and recognizable silhouette family
container material, construction, rim, base and real components
beverage layers, inclusions, garnish and fill relationships
verified brand state and exact authorized glyph content
rerender: all product pixels and antialiased boundaries
rim and base ellipses for the target camera
highlights, reflections, refraction, transmission and condensation
contact, cast shadow, caustic, grain, sharpness and white balance
forbidden: source-camera rim ellipse retained in a new viewpoint
source highlight or shadow retained under target lighting
flat front-facing label plane pasted onto a turned vessel

camera_reconciliation.target_authority: resolved photographic style camera and active scene slot override the source camera while preserving physical product construction
required_cues: rim ellipse, inner opening and visible wall thickness agree with target pitch
base ellipse and side taper share the same vanishing logic
vertical axis and foreshortening agree with support-plane perspective
ice and liquid surface are viewed from the same camera as the vessel
forbidden: front-elevation product inside a high-oblique scene
parallel source edges conflicting with target convergence

lighting_reconstruction.target_authority: resolved lighting sheet and scene light map apply through the entire product volume
required_cues: key-side highlight and shadow-side falloff cross the product body
thin environment-color wrap appears on the silhouette without a bright outline
support color is reflected or refracted through transparent lower edges
contact, cast shadow and any caustic originate from the reconstructed product geometry
forbidden: product exposure independent from background exposure
uniform catalog illumination on a directional-light scene

material_reconstruction.glass: rebuild rim thickness, sidewall refraction, base mass, environment reflections and support transmission with target-camera optics
material_reconstruction.liquid: preserve recipe identity while re-solving volume shading, translucency, internal scattering, meniscus and ice occlusion under target light
material_reconstruction.opaque: rebuild diffuse and specular response with target light and local color spill; do not retain source shading
material_reconstruction.shared_scene_response: product, support plane and background share one exposure, white balance, grain field, depth response and black point

support_contact.placement: the reconstructed base intersects the support by a physically plausible sub-pixel contact band with no gap and no sunk geometry
support_contact.contact_shadow: one compact high-density core remains attached directly under the true base footprint
support_contact.cast_shadow: the attached core opens continuously into the style lighting vector and softness
support_contact.accessory_policy: do not invent a coaster, tray, saucer, napkin or pedestal; retain one only when the source product contract or active scene graph explicitly requires it
forbidden: perfect circular pedestal added for convenience
shadow beginning away from the base

image_frequency_match.grain_match: match product-region noise power and grain scale to the adjacent support at the same depth while protecting authorized glyph legibility
image_frequency_match.color_adaptation: adapt neutral reflections and shadow chroma to the local scene without shifting beverage identity colors

brand_stage.order: reconstruct product geometry and scene lighting first; restore verified branding on the final target surface last
brand_stage.surface_behavior: authorized glyphs follow target curvature, foreshortening, occlusion, highlight and material response rather than remaining a flat frontal decal
brand_stage.exact_asset_policy: when exact lettering is required, use the source brand asset and target-surface mask after integration; uncertainty remains needs_review

hard_fail: source and target camera perspectives conflict
product and scene lighting directions conflict
base contact or cast shadow is detached
product edge halo exceeds one pixel at delivery resolution
transparent material lacks local environment reflection or refraction
